de: The Battle of Rivoli is fought with a decisive French victory by Napoleon Bonaparte, marking the beginning of the end of the War of the First Coalition and the start of French hegemony over Italy for two decades.

te: The siege of Mantua ends after eight months when Count Dagobert Sigmund von Wurmser surrenders the fortress of Mantua t…
dz: 对曼图瓦的围困在达戈伯特·西格蒙德·冯·沃姆瑟伯爵将曼图瓦的要塞投降给拿破仑·波拿巴后八个月后结束. 曼图阿的倒台确保了法国对意大利北部的控制,并标志着1796-1797年意大利战役的结束,为第一联军战争的结束奠定了基础.
de: The siege of Mantua ends after eight months when Count Dagobert Sigmund von Wurmser surrenders the fortress of Mantua to Napoleon Bonaparte. The fall of Mantua secures French control over Northern Italy and marks the beginning of the conclusion of the Italian campaign of 1796-1797, and sets the stage for the end of the War of the First Coalition.
